checks.label: Read the document that holds the answer
checks.because: each input names the documents that hold its answer

checks.label: Looked something up before answering
checks.because: instructions: no grounded advice until the material is in context

checks.label: Used what it read
checks.ask: Where does the substance of the answer come from — the tool results in the thread, or somewhere else?

options.grounded: Every specific claim traces to something a tool returned.
options.partly_grounded: The main recommendation is supported, but at least one specific claim is not.
options.unsupported: The main recommendation is not in anything a tool returned.

checks.because: instructions: never invent a name; trace every specific to a tier

checks.label: Understood the question
checks.ask: Did the answer address what this person actually asked?

options.answered_it: It addressed the question that was asked.
options.answered_adjacent: It answered a related but different question.
options.too_generic: Generic advice that never engages the specifics.
options.asked_to_clarify: It asked a clarifying question instead of answering. These questions are self-contained.

checks.label: Got the answer right
checks.ask: Compare the final answer with the REFERENCE_ANSWER. Judge the substance, not wording, length or tone.

levels.name: misses_the_point
levels.means: Does not carry the reference's central claim.

levels.name: partial
levels.means: Carries part of it, omits something load-bearing.

levels.name: better
levels.means: Same substance plus something useful and true.
